info.name: Purchase Chain
info.description:
Rhythm ERP Purchase Chain (PO -> Gate Pass -> GRN -> QC -> Purchase Booking).

Start with Setup > Discover Context: its test script mirrors ChainContextDiscoverer.discover() and writes the tenant FK values to pur_* vars plus a consolidated pur_ctx JSON (supplier with addresses, a PO-usable item from Item Master, HSN tax rate, and best-effort stored-PO header defaults). No stored PO is required.

Then run the Create requests in order: PO -> GP -> GRN -> QC -> PB. Each Create stores its record id in a pur_* env var (pur_po_id, pur_gp_id, pur_grn_id, pur_qc_id, pur_pb_id) that the next Create reads, so the chain stays linked. Create requests only read pur_* vars and do NOT call the API - same pattern as pages/private_b2b/scripts/purchase_chain.py.

All endpoints match purchase_chain.py: /procure_to_pay/purchase_order/, /procure_to_pay/gate-pass/, /procure_to_pay/grn/, /procure_to_pay/quality-control/, /procure_to_pay/purchase-booking/ (list/detail/create).

Setup: set base_url, token, tenant_id in your Postman environment, run Discover Context, and check pur_sniff_status. List requests are pure reads.

item.name: Setup
item.description: One-shot tenant discovery. Run Discover Context first — it resolves the supplier (with addresses), a PO-usable item (from Item Master), the HSN tax rate, and writes the tenant FK values to pur_* vars plus a consolidated pur_ctx JSON. After that, Create PO (and later the rest of the chain) just reads those vars — no stored PO is required.

request.description: Entry request = GET the Supplier list. The test script runs the whole tenant discovery in serial, decoupled stages (mirrors ChainContextDiscoverer.discover()): supplier (first one with ship-from + bill-from addresses), item from Item Master (HSN/UOM required), HSN tax rate, and best-effort stored-PO header defaults. Every stage is guarded independently and updates pur_sniff_status, so one failing stage never blocks the rest.

item.name: PO
item.description:
Purchase Order — first step of the chain.

List PO sniffs the supplier + item + header defaults from an existing PO and its Supplier, and stores them in pur_* env vars. Create PO reads those, generates a fresh qty (500-2000) / rate (500-6000), computes amount / tax / total, and saves pur_po_id.

exec: console.log('List PO is a pure read - run Setup > Discover Context to (re)build the pur_* tenant context. Current status: ' + (pm.environment.get('pur_sniff_status') || 'Discover not run yet'));

request.description: Reads pur_* sniffed by List PO, generates a fresh qty (500-2000) and rate (500-6000), computes amount/tax/total. Test saves pur_po_id. Mirrors _po_items_from in purchase_chain.py.

exec: var hint = (!sn || sn === 'running' || sn.indexOf('running') === 0) ? ' Discover appears not to have completed - re-run Setup > Discover Context and check View > Show Postman Console (Ctrl+Alt+C).' : '';

throw new Error('Missing PO deps: ' + poMissing.join(', ') + '. Run Setup > Discover Context first (sniff status: ' + (sn || 'Discover not run yet') + ').' + hint + ' Or set these values manually in the environment: ' + poMissing.join(', '));

var storedRate = parseFloat(pm.environment.get('pur_po_rate') || 0);
var rate = storedRate > 0 ? storedRate : r2(500 + Math.random() * 5500);
if (!id) { throw new Error('PO create failed: ' + pm.response.text()); }

item.name: GP
item.description:
Gate Pass — second step, linked to the PO (po_ref_id_id).

List GP sniffs delivery_type from an existing Gate Pass. Create GP reads pur_po_id + the sniffed item/UOM/HSN and saves pur_gp_id.

exec: console.log('List GP is a pure read - run Setup > Discover Context to resolve delivery_type (pur_gp_delivery_type). Current: ' + (pm.environment.get('pur_gp_delivery_type') || 'not set'));

request.description: Linked GP (po_ref_id_id set). Reads pur_po_id + sniffed item/UOM/HSN/delivery_type. Test saves pur_gp_id. Mirrors _gp_items_from in purchase_chain.py.

exec: var hint = (!sn || sn.indexOf('running') === 0) ? ' Discover appears not to have completed - re-run Setup > Discover Context and check View > Show Postman Console (Ctrl+Alt+C).' : '';

throw new Error('Missing GP deps: ' + gpMissing.join(', ') + '. Run Setup > Discover Context first (sniff status: ' + (sn || 'Discover not run yet') + ').' + hint + ' Or set these values manually in the environment: ' + gpMissing.join(', '));
if (!id) { throw new Error('GP create failed: ' + pm.response.text()); }

item.name: GRN
item.description:
Goods Receipt Note — third step, linked to the GP and PO.

Create GRN reads pur_po_id + pur_gp_id and the sniffed item fields. Single-flow quantities: po_quantity = po_balance_quantity = gate_pass_quantity = qty. Test saves pur_grn_id.

request.description: Linked GRN (po_ref_id_id + gate_pass_ref_id_id). Reads pur_qty/pur_rate from the PO run. po_quantity = po_balance_quantity = qty (single flow). Test saves pur_grn_id. Mirrors _grn_items_from in purchase_chain.py.

item.name: QC
item.description:
Quality Check — fourth step, linked to PO + GP + GRN.

List QC sniffs quality parameters (qc_parameter_details) and bag type (qc_bags_details[0].type_of_bags_ref_id) from an existing QC. Create QC ports _compute_qc_line_fields from purchase_chain.py into JS (empty bag 0-12, deduction 0-5, discount 0-5, all amounts rounded 6dp), saves pur_qc_id and the computed qc_details array (pur_qc_lines) for the PB step to mirror.

exec: // pure read - QC params (CQP) and bags_type (Packages) are resolved by Setup > Discover Context

request.description: Reads pur_po_id + pur_gp_id + pur_grn_id. Computes all QC amount fields in the pre-request (port of _compute_qc_line_fields). Test saves pur_qc_id + pur_qc_lines (food for the PB step).

item.name: PB
item.description:
Purchase Booking — final step, mirrors the QC lines.

List PB sniffs supplier_payment_terms_ref_id from an existing Purchase Booking. Create PB reads pur_qc_id + pur_grn_id + pur_po_id and the saved pur_qc_lines, ports _pb_items_from_qc / build_pb_line / build_pb_payload from purchase_chain.py (labour 10-300, transport 0-500, random IGST vs CGST+SGST, total_txn = amount - discount + tax - labour). Test saves pur_pb_id.
